data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.question: professor
sections.summary: A senior teacher or researcher at a university who is an expert in their subject.

senses.definition: a teacher of the highest rank at a university or college who is an expert in their subject
examples: The professor published a new research paper.

answers.answer: The professor published a new research paper.
The professor studied under the student.
A professor is a type of assignment.

sections.question: project
sections.summary: A planned piece of work or activity with a specific aim, often done over a period of time.

senses.definition: a planned piece of work or activity that has a specific aim and is completed over a period of time, often involving research or cooperation
examples: They worked together on a group project.

answers.answer: They worked together on a group project.
They projected the homework yesterday.
A project is a job position.

sections.question: qualification
sections.summary: An official record showing that you have completed a course or passed an exam.

senses.definition: an official record or certificate showing that you have successfully completed a course of study or have the skills and knowledge needed for a particular job
examples: She has the right qualifications for the job.

answers.answer: She has the right qualifications for the job.
She qualificationed last year.
A qualification is a lecture hall.

sections.question: seminar
sections.summary: A small class or meeting for discussion on a topic in depth, often at a university.

senses.definition: a class at a university or college in which a small group of students discuss a topic in depth with a teacher, or a short training event for professionals
examples: He attended a seminar on climate change.

answers.answer: He attended a seminar on climate change.
He seminated his homework yesterday.
A seminar is a written certificate.

sections.question: skill
sections.summary: An ability to do something well, developed through training or practice.

senses.definition: a particular ability or type of expertise that can be developed through training and practice

answers.answer: Communication is an important skill.
She skilled her homework carefully.
A skill is a university building.

sections.question: staff
sections.summary: All the people employed by an organization.

senses.definition: all the people who work for a particular organization or employer, considered as a group
examples: The staff were helpful and friendly.

answers.answer: The staff were helpful and friendly.
The staffs were helpful yesterday.
Staff is a type of assignment.

sections.question: teacher
sections.summary: A person whose job is to instruct or educate students.

senses.definition: a person whose job is to teach students, especially in a school or other educational institution
examples: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.

answers.answer: The teacher explained the lesson clearly.
The teachered the students yesterday.
A teacher is a university degree.

sections.question: trainee
sections.summary: A person who is being trained to do a job or learn a skill.

senses.definition: a person who is learning the skills needed for a particular job or role, usually under the supervision of an experienced person
examples: The trainee is learning how to use the system.

answers.answer: The trainee is learning how to use the system.
The trainee trained the manager.
A trainee is a diploma.

sections.question: worker
sections.summary: A person who does a job as part of their employment.

senses.definition: a person who is employed to do a job, especially one involving physical or manual work
examples: The worker arrived early for the shift.

answers.answer: The worker arrived early for the shift.
The worker workeded all night.

sections.question: workshop
sections.summary: A short, practical session where people learn skills or discuss ideas together.

senses.definition: a meeting or series of meetings in which people learn practical skills or discuss ideas through active participation rather than just listening
examples: She attended a workshop on public speaking.

answers.answer: She attended a workshop on public speaking.
She workshopped her homework yesterday.
A workshop is a university degree.
